Several hours (includes hunting 200 Dragons, opening 5 chests and killing 4 bosses)

Annual event (14 January to 12 February) about the First Dragon, son of Garsharak. {npc:Tamoril} tells you where the four descendants of the First Dragon live: you pass the trial of each (power, treasure, knowledge and life), kill {creature:Tazhadur}, {creature:Kalyassa}, {creature:Gelidrazah the Frozen} and {creature:Zorvorax} and use their trophies to open the First Dragon Lair. At the end you face {creature:The First Dragon} as a team and earn the {wiki:Festive Outfits|Festive Outfits} and several reward chests.

They say new clues have surfaced about the first dragon that had direct contact with humans, Garsharak's son. Being a real chatterbox, Vigintius may know something about it, so make sure you squeeze out of him every bit of information he has.
**Premium** account and minimum level 40 (recommended 200; for the final fight, level 250+ and knights at least 300).
You can only **start** the quest between **14 January and 12 February**.
{wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest|In Service of Yalahar Quest}: access to the Magician Quarter to talk to {npc:Tamoril} (not needed for the treasure chests).
{wiki:Barbarian Test Quest|Barbarian Test Quest} completed: to travel with {npc:Buddel} to Okolnir (boss Gelidrazah).
{wiki:The New Frontier Quest|The New Frontier Quest} mission 1: access to Zao (boss Kalyassa).
Team of up to 15 players for the final fight (recommended: 3 Elite Knights, 4 Elder Druids, 4 Master Sorcerers and 4 Royal Paladins).

Backpack (once per event/year) with: 3 {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}, {item:Ancient Coin}, {item:Draken Sulphur}, 2 {item:Seacrest Hair}, 2 {item:Mystical Hourglass|Mystical Hourglasses}, {item:Blue Gem}, {item:Red Gem}, {item:Yellow Gem}, 2 {item:Demon Horn|Demon Horns}, 2 {item:Slime Heart|Slime Hearts}, 2 {item:Energy Vein|Energy Veins}, 2 {item:Petrified Scream|Petrified Screams}, 2 {item:Brimstone Shell|Brimstone Shells}, 2 {item:Deepling Warts}, 2 {item:Wyrm Scale|Wyrm Scales} and 2 {item:Hellspawn Tail|Hellspawn Tails}
Rewards from the {item:Dragon Chest|Dragon Chests} (see Kalyassa's table) and the achievement **Treasure Hunter** if you open all 20
Section 7: when you use the four boss trophies on the square in front of the centre of the door.
The guide states **permanent** access; the quest is an annual event (14 January to 12 February).
The four bosses can be done in any order. Do not forget to **pick up the trophy** from each one before leaving the lair: they are the keys to the First Dragon Lair.
The 200 Dragons from previous events count; if it is your first time, you start from zero when the event opens (having 200 in the Bestiary is not enough).
Access to the First Dragon Lair is **permanent**: once you have used the four trophies on the door, you do not need to repeat it.
Go to the final fight with an organised team: there are several phases and coordination prevents deaths.

This part is optional: it gives context to the story and a lead to Yalahar. You can start straight with Tamoril (section 2). {npc:Vigintius}, on the island of Vigintia, heard about an explorer who found an ancient inscription beneath Thais.
Go down in the Ancient Temple
Go to the **Ancient Temple**, just outside the gates of Thais, and go down **twice** at this spot to floor -2.
Way down in the Ancient Temple
Walk **south** and **west** and go down here. Then walk **northwest** and go up here. Walk a little **west** and you see the {item:Ancient Inscription}.

Use the {item:Dead Explorer} on the **left** of the inscription to find the {item:First Dragon (Book)} in the form of a {item:Blurred Transcript}. The text gives you the context of the quest and a lead to head for **Yalahar**. To leave, go back the same way: go down where you went up ({coord:32272,32132,10}), go up where you went down ({coord:32332,32189,9}) and climb the two floors of the Ancient Temple (use the {item:Rope} where needed).

Go to **Yalahar** (for example, by boat from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}). From the city centre enter the Magician Quarter, to the **northeast** (this district has no gate mechanism: you enter directly from the centre), and go up at this spot to {npc:Tamoril}. To leave, go back to the centre of Yalahar through the same gate and take a boat at the harbour.

Say {key:hi}, {key:First Dragon}, {key:rumours}, {key:descendants}, {key:draconic incitements}, {key:find} and then {key:yes} **twice**. The quest appears in your quest log and he tells you where the four gem teleports are.
Tamoril is there all year round, but the quest can only be started between 14 January and 12 February.

Kill **200 ordinary {creature:Dragon|Dragons}**. {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} and other types of dragon do not count. Good places: {wiki:Crystal Lakes|Crystal Lakes} (53 dragons together) or the first floor of the {wiki:Darashia Dragon Lair|Darashia Dragon Lair}.
Dragons killed in previous events count. The Bestiary does not.

The {wiki:Darashia Dragon Lair|Darashia Dragon Lair} is in the desert **north** of Darashia; the entrance has a **level 40** {item:Gate of Expertise}. Go down to the **last floor**: the {item:Large Glowing Emerald} is in the middle of the stone circle. With the 200 dragons killed, step on it to be teleported to {creature:Tazhadur}'s lair.

Kill {creature:Tazhadur} and **take the {item:Tooth of Tazhadur}** from the corpse before leaving. To leave, step on the {item:Large Glowing Emerald} that also exists inside the lair: you return to the Darashia Dragon Lair. From there go back up the same way to the entrance (bring a {item:Rope}).
You have to open **5** {item:Dragon Chest|Dragon Chests} (out of 20 possible). The book {wiki:Dragon Hoards (Book)|Dragon Hoards} indicates the area of 19 of them; the twentieth is in Goroma.
Choose 5 chests from the table (the easiest ones for you) and open them. Each one gives a reward.
If you open the **20** Dragon Chests you get the **Treasure Hunter** achievement.

The {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks|Dragonblaze Peaks} are in **Zao**, north of the steppe (you need to have started mission 1 of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest|The New Frontier Quest}). Get to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship} (from Kazordoon with {npc:Brodrosch}, {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), leave to the Zao steppe and head **north** to the mountains; climb the mountain stairs to the {item:Large Glowing Ruby}. With 5 treasures collected, step on the ruby to enter {creature:Kalyassa}'s lair.

Kill {creature:Kalyassa} and **take the {item:Horn of Kalyassa}** before leaving. The wiki does not describe the exit of this lair: look for the teleport back inside it. To leave Zao, go back to Farmine and take the Steamship from {npc:Thorgrin} ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}).
5. Boss of Knowledge: Gelidrazah the Frozen

Go to **Svargrond** (by boat, for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). In Svargrond, go **south** to {npc:Buddel}'s boat and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:okolnir}, {key:yes} (50 gp). You disembark in Okolnir. From Buddel, go up **3 times** to reach the teleport and the NPC {npc:Gelidrazah's Thirst}.
From Buddel, go up 3 times to reach the teleport
Say {key:hi} and {key:yes} twice. Then answer the questions in this order: {key:Tahmehe}, {key:Ishara} and {key:Svir}.
Name of the princess who fell in love with a Thaian nobleman during the reign of pharaoh Uthemath
Author of the book 'The Language of the Wolves'
Ancient race that travelled the sky in cloud ships

Step on the {item:Large Glowing Sapphire} to enter the lair of {creature:Gelidrazah the Frozen}. Kill her and **take the {item:Scale of Gelidrazah}** before leaving. To leave, step on the {item:Large Glowing Sapphire} that also exists inside the lair: you return to Okolnir. Go down the 3 floors to {npc:Buddel} and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to go back to Svargrond.
Enter each of these three places until you receive the corresponding server message:
The {wiki:Edron Vampire Crypt|Edron Vampire Crypt} is **north** of Edron. Go down to the last floor and step on the {item:Large Glowing Amethyst} to be teleported to {creature:Zorvorax}'s lair.

Kill {creature:Zorvorax} and **take the {item:Bones of Zorvorax}** before leaving. To leave, step on the {item:Large Glowing Amethyst} that also exists inside the lair: you return to the last floor of the crypt. There, the teleport at {coord:33019,31605,11} takes you next to the Stone Blocks near the entrance ({coord:33052,31698,8}).

With the {item:Tooth of Tazhadur}, the {item:Horn of Kalyassa}, the {item:Scale of Gelidrazah} and the {item:Bones of Zorvorax}, go to the spot in the desert shown on the map, in the Kha'zeel mountains (near Ankrahmun).
Use {spell:Levitate} up **3 times** and then go up the ramp to the **north** until you reach this area.
Use the four boss trophies on the square in front of the **centre of the door**. You gain **permanent** access to the {wiki:First Dragon Lair|First Dragon Lair}.
Going down to the Mystic Flame
Use the square to enter the lair and fight your way down to the **last floor**, where there is a {item:Mystic Flame}.
Step on the flame to go to {npc:Kizar}'s room. Go **south** to a teleport that takes you to a room with a {item:Lever|lever}.
Pulling the lever starts the final fight right away. Make sure the whole team (up to 15 players) is ready.
The room before the lever room, with the NPC Kizar
The lever room: a team of up to 15 players can enter this fight

After you pull the lever, the team is split into groups of 3 across **5 rooms**. Each room has a {creature:Fallen Challenger} and a teleport (which sends you back to the butler's room). Kill the dragon: it turns into a {item:Mystic Flame} that takes you to the boss room.
When you enter the flame, **start moving right away** so you do not get cornered if you are the first to arrive. If possible, coordinate your entry.
Phase 2: transform the Spirit of Fertility

In the boss room there are 5 {creature:Unbeatable Dragon|Unbeatable Dragons}, several {creature:Dragon Warden|Dragon Wardens} (they can be killed but reappear shortly after) and a {creature:Spirit of Fertility}. Lure the Spirit of Fertility from the **right** side (water area, where it appears) to the **left** side (grass area) and make it step on the {item:Dry Flower}. It turns into an {creature:Angry Plant}.
The Spirit of Fertility takes damage from the creatures in the room, but druids can heal it with {spell:Mass Healing}.

Kill the {creature:Angry Plant}: its corpse is a {item:Flower Bowl (First Dragon)|Flower Bowl}. Lure an {creature:Unbeatable Dragon} on top of that flower: it becomes a {creature:Somewhat Beatable Dragon} and the team can kill it. Repeat everything until all 5 Unbeatable Dragons are dead.
Good strategy: a blocker holds the Unbeatable Dragons at the north or south of the room while the rest of the team lures the Spirit and kills the dragons.

With the 5 dragons dead, **6 {creature:Dragon Essence|Dragon Essences}** appear. They have lots of health and hit hard. They all share **the same health** (damage to one counts for all), so use single-target attacks instead of area attacks to kill them faster.
Shooters: watch out for the damage from the Dragon Essences.

After the 6 Dragon Essences, {creature:The First Dragon} appears. Focus all the damage on him. The {creature:Dragon Warden|Dragon Wardens} keep appearing, and the boss teleports around the room several times, so there is no point trying to corner him.
After you kill the boss you are teleported to the rewards room. Talk to {npc:The First Dragon (NPC)} and say {key:reward}: you receive the {wiki:Festive Outfits|Festive Outfits}.
Open the three chests in the room:

Backpack with 3 {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens}, {item:Ancient Coin}, {item:Draken Sulphur}, 2 {item:Seacrest Hair}, 2 {item:Mystical Hourglass|Mystical Hourglasses}, {item:Blue Gem}, {item:Red Gem}, {item:Yellow Gem}, 2 {item:Demon Horn|Demon Horns}, 2 {item:Slime Heart|Slime Hearts}, 2 {item:Energy Vein|Energy Veins}, 2 {item:Petrified Scream|Petrified Screams}, 2 {item:Brimstone Shell|Brimstone Shells}, 2 {item:Deepling Warts}, 2 {item:Wyrm Scale|Wyrm Scales} and 2 {item:Hellspawn Tail|Hellspawn Tails}

The wiki does not describe the exit of the rewards room. If you cannot find an exit teleport, go back through the lair to the door in the Kha'zeel mountains and go down the hill the same way (ramp to the south and {spell:Levitate} down 3 times) to the desert.
The quest is a seasonal event: it runs from 14 January to 12 February.
{npc:Tamoril} is a direct descendant of Kalyassa and fell out with his mother and uncles: that is why he sends you to challenge them.
